description: Uploads one native ChatGPT attachment to the connected Magic Hour account: PNG/JPEG/WebP images, MP4/MOV/WebM video, or MP3/WAV/M4A/FLAC/Ogg/WebM audio, up to 20 MiB. Set media_type to the attachment's actual kind: image, video or audio. For multiple references, call separately and keep each returned file_path paired with the intended input. Pass the real attachment through the file parameter; a bare file ID, filename or chat-local path is not the raw MCP file object. Does not generate media or spend generation credits.
name: upload_chatgpt_media
title: Upload attached media
